title: How Much Does Adobe Illustrator Cost? Plans and Prices
summary: Adobe Illustrator price varies by subscription plan, with monthly and annual billing. Compare features across tiers to decide which plan suits your budget.
body_markdown:
## Illustrator costs over three years


Over 36 months, the same Illustrator subscription costs between $791.64 and $1,133.64, a $342 range that **depends only on how you pay for it** , meaning one payment option will cost you $342 more than another.


That gap is the price of keeping the option to cancel.


### Illustrator single-app cost for freelancers


On its own, Illustrator costs[$263.88 a year when prepaid](https://photutorial.com/adobe-illustrator-pricing/) , $275.88 a year when billed monthly on an annual contract, and $377.88 a year month-to-month. Over 36 months that's $791.64, $827.64 and $1,133.64.


Prepaying saves $36 over three years compared with monthly billing, which is small. **Month-to-month costs about $306 more** than the annual contract, so unless your work is genuinely seasonal, take the annual term billed monthly.


### Designer who needs three or more Adobe apps


If you need three or more apps, Creative Cloud Pro runs[$779.88 a year prepaid](https://photutorial.com/adobe-illustrator-pricing/) , $839.88 billed monthly on an annual term, and $1,259.88 month-to-month. Billed monthly, that's $2,519.64 over 36 months.


If other apps are priced like Illustrator, three of them add up to about $827.64 a year, so Pro starts to pay for itself at roughly three apps.


Month-to-month Pro reaches $3,779.64 over three years, about $1,440 more than prepaying.


### Student and teacher pricing


The student plan costs $19.99 a month for the first year and $39.99 a month after that.


That's only $252 more than the single-app annual contract, and it buys the full set of apps rather than one, so the full suite costs less than two single-app subscriptions.


If you qualify, **it's the strongest value in the chart** . Check your eligibility each year, because the price you pay once you stop qualifying is the standard one.


Get a quote before you multiply anything for a five-person team, because business licences are priced differently from individual plans.


As a benchmark, five individual single-app seats at the annual rate cost $1,379.40 a year. If the quote comes in far above that, the extra is paying for centralised billing and seat management, and you should decide whether your team uses them.
